title: Lost at the airport
instructions: Leo havalimanında kayıp bavulunu bildiriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; Leo bir bilgiyi düzeltiyor ve olumsuz cümleler var. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Yes, I hope so. My suitcase isn't here. I was on the flight from Rome.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What time did your flight arrive?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: It arrived at nine thirty, but we waited on the plane for an hour.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: OK. Can you describe your suitcase?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: It's big and grey. No, sorry, it's dark blue. My grey one is at home.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Big and dark blue. Is there a name on it?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Yes, there's a small red card with my name, Leo Rossi.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Clothes, two books and a present for my sister. My laptop isn't in it. It's in my small bag, here.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Good. We usually find bags in one or two days. Where are you staying?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: At the Park Hotel, near the station. I'm here until Friday.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Fine. We can send the suitcase to your hotel. Can I have your phone number?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Of course. Here is my card with my number.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Thank you, Mister Rossi. We'll call you tomorrow.

questions.evidence: I was on the flight from Rome.

questions.feedback: Önce gri (grey) diyor, sonra düzeltiyor: lacivert (dark blue). Gri olan evde. Kırmızı olan isim kartı.

questions.prompt: What is NOT in the suitcase?
questions.feedback: Bilgisayar bavulda değil (isn't in it), küçük çantasında.

options: at a hotel near the station
at a hotel near the airport
questions.feedback: İstasyonun yakınındaki Park Hotel'de kalıyor. Kız kardeşi yalnızca hediyenin sahibi.
questions.evidence: At the Park Hotel, near the station.

questions.prompt: When will the officer call Leo?
questions.feedback: Görevli yarın (tomorrow) arayacak. "One or two days" çantaların genelde bulunma süresi, cuma Leo'nun kalış süresi.
